ref-001.description: Large residential development in the Wilanów district with 204 parking spaces. The independent PARKER-C100 platforms give every resident flexible access to their vehicle.

ref-002.description: A bank's corporate headquarters with 16 parking spaces on a limited footprint. The PARKER-S100 systems were chosen specifically for the low ceiling height of the underground garage.

ref-003.description: Luxury hotel on Poland's Baltic Sea coast. The underground PARKER-O100 systems disappear completely below the surface, preserving the hotel's aesthetic appearance.

ref-004.description: Modern apartment building with 68 parking spaces. The PARKER-C100 platforms double the parking capacity in the underground garage.

ref-005.description: A combination of 8 PARKER-C100 Basic and 5 PARKER-S120 Basic platforms. The flexible solution meets the varied requirements of the residents.

ref-006.description: Automated parking system with 17 PALLET-T10 sliding platforms. The system prevents misparked vehicles and enables efficient use of space.

ref-007.description: Parking facility in the popular Baltic Sea spa town. The MODULO systems provide reliable parking for holidaymakers and residents alike.

ref-008.description: Holiday resort on the island of Wolin. The space-saving parking systems maximize the number of parking spaces for the property's guests.

ref-brno-podebradova.description: Underground garage of a Brno residential project realised by our team: inclined PARKER-S platforms double the parking spaces despite limited ceiling height – cleanly integrated into the new building.
ref-brno-podebradova.name: Brno Poděbradova Residential Project

ref-brno-tiefgarage.description: Our own installation in a Brno underground garage: two-level parking platforms with galvanized decks and yellow safety railings – installed and serviced by our team.
ref-brno-tiefgarage.name: Brno Underground Garage
